draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement

Dear Shakti Cement Team,

We are writing to inform you that vehicle DL41GG9786 has experienced a breakdown and has been replaced by vehicle DL30AN8381. The replacement vehicle has been dispatched from our Delhi hub to continue the Delhi to Delhi route. We are currently estimating the delivery window based on route distance and will provide a confirmed ETA shortly. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
